issue_context.summary: Swapping Alt and Control in Keyboard Manager reportedly disables configured three- and four-finger touchpad taps while the key swap itself continues to work.

actions.label: Reproduce touchpad tap with modifier swap

reproduce.title: Check touchpad gesture delivery with Alt/Control swap
reproduce.version_requirement: Current PowerToys development build on Windows with precision touchpad
prerequisites: Configure Windows Touchpad three- and four-finger actions.
Use a physical precision touchpad; note whether test window is elevated.
steps: With Keyboard Manager off, test configured three/four-finger gestures over desktop and normal application.
Enable Keyboard Manager and swap Alt with Control; repeat and verify ordinary key swap works.
Record window-type variation; test reported F22/F24 remap workaround only as control.
If available, inspect key chord delivered before and after remap.
reproduce.expected_result: Configured gestures still fire after Alt/Control swap; if not, the observed chord identifies whether remapping changes OS gesture input.

proposed_fixes.title: Preserve native touchpad gesture chords through modifier remapping
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: Windows touchpad gestures arrive as synthetic Win/Ctrl/Shift/F22-or-F24 chords and swapping Alt/Control changes or consumes part of the chord before the gesture handler sees it. Exact chord/OS path is unverified on current builds.
plan: On current Windows with precision touchpad, establish gestures with Keyboard Manager off, then repeat with Alt/Control swap.
Compare delivered key chord before/after remap; use reported F22/F24 shortcut workaround only as a diagnostic control.
If remapping transforms native gesture input, preserve the OS gesture chord at the appropriate boundary and add focused modifier-swap/gesture-key tests.
verification: Verify configured three/four-finger actions trigger before and after swap on current build.
Verify ordinary Alt/Control remapping remains correct and no workaround is needed.
Repeat over desktop and normal/elevated app to test reported window dependence.

confidence.rationale: Original repro and later workaround support an interaction, but current behavior and exact gesture chord are not independently verified.
